title: hive-pool release-question: request body
description: Records the owner's disposition released for the applied answer of a question that holds work, and releases its word hold in the same transaction, with the release's receipt as the hold's released_by: the work is free to proceed as the answer directs. Refused with pool.question_unanswered for a question with no applied answer, pool.question_closed for one already released, completed or moot, and pool.decision_item for a question whose held item, as it stands in the transaction, is a decision item (deliverable decision) with no live work beneath it, an item neither archived nor a decision item, which is completed instead. The envelope's expected_revisions names the question's record revision. One of the operations the Mind's word persists through: refused with authority_insufficient unless the request is a handoff from the hive-word command of the package word. See spec/word.md.

note.description: The owner's disposition note, its own words on the card, never the Hive Mind's.

evidence.description: What the owner did on the answer, where it names a record.

requested_by.description: The caller of the hive-word request, recorded as the disposition's by.
